rounds.text: Fundviser Capital (India) Ltd demonstrates superior operational efficiency compared to its industry peers, highlighted by a return on assets of 5.29% which comfortably outperforms the sector benchmark of 1.79% [E8]. Furthermore, the company generates a return on capital employed of 7.59% against a sector benchmark of 5.72%, beating the broader sector median ROCE of 6.1% [E10, E70]. Market participants are actively recognizing this fundamental strength, as evidenced by the stock trading robustly at 77% of the way up its 52-week range [E5]. Conceded: [E1, E2, E4, E6, E7, E9, E11, E12, E13, E20, E36, E37, E38, E62, E63].
